summary: The dependency, imports, lockfile and CI checks appear to satisfy the Animas rename criteria, but the change includes substantial edits outside the files named by the issue. Scope non-negotiable 4 is not met.

findings.message: The issue names pyproject.toml, src/, tests/ and uv.lock, but the diff also changes AGENTS.md, DESIGN.md, README.md, docs/adr/*, scripts/* and skills/*, including legacy-agent→home-swe-home renames that are not the Animas rename. Revert the out-of-scope edits or get the scope explicitly expanded before approval.
